description: Swings a Heavy Vibroblade weapon at a fixed target through the native attack-roll and damage-roll hooks and records each swing: the attack result and the physical damage rolled for a landed swing.
inputs: Attacker and target are two nw_bandit001, 1.5 m apart, the target held still; the attacker wields b_greatsword (accuracy 21, evasion 18, weapon DMG 8, base item GreatSword, properties [DMG/0/8/0, Delay/0/30/0, OnHitCastSpell/125/39/-1, RequiresSkill/39/0/0]). Random is seeded with 20261032 once, then 30 swings are resolved in one step. Result 1 is a hit, 3 a critical hit, 4 a miss, 2 a deflection; damage is 0 unless the swing landed.
